hypothesis: Weak held-out IR identity does not imply useless foreground evidence. Diagnose fish-versus-background discrimination before spending on another association head.
sources: Existing actual November IR and matched RGB native36 candidate embeddings; exact original candidate index and frozen RGB reference. All fits use Train6 only.
labels: Original Train candidate label>=0 is fish, label=-1 is the original physically sampled background. No relabeling from Dev/Test.
models: Ordinary L2 logistic controls: frozen RGB reference alone, reference plus native RGB, reference plus actual native IR. Joint input capacity is equal; all three matched backbone seeds.
weights: Equal video and equal positive/negative mass within each video. Train-only coordinate standardization, std floor0.001.
Dev: All4834 frames, both original RGB and paired-new detector streams. IoU>=0.5 to a class1 GT box is a foreground example, IoU<=0.2 to all positive/ignored boxes is background. Ambiguous/ignored rows excluded. This is a posthoc diagnostic, never an inference GT input.
Test: No Test read or fitting; no tracking improvement or innovation is established by AUC alone.
